outputSignals.signal: GPIO-level asynchronous UART TX, idle high, 8N1, LSB first

connectedDevices.device: On-board J-Link VCOM bridge for the default reference path
Optional external TTL USB-to-UART adapter for a non-VCOM GPIO path

description.summary: Software-driven, transmit-only UART reference implementation using a GPIO output and GPT timer-based bit-period control when a hardware SCI/UART channel is unavailable or reserved.

classification.technology: GPIO and timer-driven asynchronous serial transmission

board.name: FPB-RA2E3
board.validationStatus: do not infer full hardware validation from metadata

board.name: FPB-RA4E2
board.validationStatus: VCOM bridge behavior reported in repository documentation; full PES validation not claimed here

dependencies.dependency: LLVM Embedded Toolchain for Arm in the documented FPB-RA2E3 example

hardwareRequirements.requirement: GPIO output capable of idle-high UART signaling
GPT clock and prescaler capable of producing the selected bit period
Interrupt latency compatible with the selected baud rate

capabilities.capability: Generate UART-style transmit signaling on one GPIO output
Transmit bytes and null-terminated ASCII strings asynchronously
Use a GPT interrupt to advance one UART bit period at a time
Queue output in a statically allocated transmit ring buffer
Report deterministic status and buffer-full errors
Expose generated or preset configuration checks before operation

configuration.parameter: GPIO TX pin; default reference mapping is board specific
One validated-list candidate from 1200 through 115200; actual support claims require evidence
8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit
Static compile-time or generated buffer size
Return error; no silent overwrite and no blocking wait
On-board VCOM by default; optional external TTL adapter for non-VCOM GPIO

executionModel.initialization: Generate or select configuration, validate it, bind GPIO and GPT resources, and establish an idle-high TX output before writes are accepted.
executionModel.runtimeBehavior: Application-context writes enqueue complete requests without blocking. The GPT ISR consumes queued bytes, outputs a low start bit, eight LSB-first data bits, and a high stop bit, then returns the pin to idle high when the queue empties.
executionModel.concurrency: Main-loop or task context produces ring-buffer data and the GPT ISR consumes it. Shared ring-buffer metadata requires a short deterministic critical section or validated atomic method.
executionModel.memoryModel: Static, generated, or application-provided storage only; no dynamic allocation.

useCases.useCase: Factory test and diagnostic result output

limitations.limitation: Phase 1 is TX only; receive, full duplex, interactive CLI input, command parsing, flow control, DMA, and DTC are out of scope.
Write functions are not supported from ISR context.
GPIO, GPT, and baud rate are not dynamically remapped while transmission is active.
The GPIO signal is TTL logic-level UART and must not be connected directly to a true RS-232 interface.
A hardware SCI/UART function must not drive the same VCOM TX pin concurrently.

performanceCharacteristics.operatingRange: Supported baud rates: 1200, 2400, 4800, 9600, 19200, 38400, 57600, and 115200 baud. Default demo rate: 115200 baud.
performanceCharacteristics.latency: Write-call completion indicates acceptance into the transmit queue, not completion on the TX pin.
performanceCharacteristics.throughput: Determined by configured baud rate and 8N1 framing.
performanceCharacteristics.memoryUsage: Static allocation only; default transmit buffer size is 512 bytes.
performanceCharacteristics.customMetric: Design and validation target: measured baud-rate error within plus or minus 3 percent.
No more than plus or minus 10 percent of the ideal bit period.
Deterministic return-error policy; no silent data loss and no blocking wait.

resources.resource: One dedicated GPT timer channel while active
One GPT interrupt vector and board-valid priority
On-board J-Link VCOM bridge for default terminal demonstration, where available

validationCase.validatedConfiguration: FSP 6.5.0, GPT-based bit-banged UART TX, P109 VCOM path, 115200 baud, 8N1.
